system.notes:
140-foot-tall bipedal dinosaur. Sleeps within a deep jungle lake. Can be awoken or lulled to sleep by certain songs. Called "King Mogaru", hunts other kaiju.

AC 17, HP 118, ATK 3 rend (near) +10 (4d8) or force beam, MV far (swim), S +6, D +2, C +6, I -3, W +5, Ch +4, AL C, LV 25

Absorb Energy. Mogaru nullifies the first damage taken from a hostile attack each round.

Force Beam. Straight line (5' wide) extending far from Mogaru. DEX 15+ or 8d6 damage, disintegrated at 0 HP.

Immortal. Only damaged by magic sources. Immune to acid, cold, fire, and lightning. If slain, resurrects in 1d10 days and flees.
